description:
[Taxonomy H.42 — baseline response (public data only)] Quantify a patient's financial exposure to medical-debt risk given current plan, health status, and historical claim volatility.

WHEN TO USE: User is planning for a medical expense, comparing plan options, looking for financial assistance, or trying to structure a payment plan.

WHEN NOT: For billing-error analysis (scan_bill_for_errors) or appeal drafting (generate_appeal_letter).
name: financial_risk_exposure_model
